title: Narrowing happens in a modal that writes what it did

criteria.text: No chips or pills beside the results; the panel opens from one control
criteria.note: `ActiveFilterChips` and `KindFilterPills` were deleted in #174; since #1161 (2026-11-02, Don's 11-01 asks) the one header row holds the search pill and Explore carries no bottom bar, List|Map tabs or reach line; the sheet opens only through the header search's 'More filters' (`onOpenFilters`, `BrowseSurface.tsx:397`) [V]. #956 (Don, 2026-10-18 [always]) removed the last chips and pills app-wide [V]. Open question: #1161's full-screen Search panel also holds Type and When choices that write the same box, which sits close to the scenario's Not-this line 'a second entry point to the panel'; its PR says every choice writes the one box and no chip returns [A, for the PM's eye in a look]. Checked no: `tests/no-chips.test.ts` (#956) scans for `*Chip`/`*Pill` names, the `.chip` class and rounded-full chip shapes but carries no `[guards F092.1]` marker and does not catch a plain-text filter row (#624) [V grep]. Reviewed no (#174 no `Reviewed by:`; #956 and #1161 reviewed). Shipped: deploy-health green on 9dde664f, 546f0862, d1267059 [V]. Smoked: smoke-live run 41884400137 on main 49f942f0 (2026-11-04, root and explore, 10 passed) was green after every merge here; the main runs of 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 (4a632e8a) were red, the 11-06 one on member at explore 1280px ('did not open in time (twice)') and owner personas timing out, so this rests on the 11-04 run [V gh run view]; it loads the route, it does not tap.

criteria.text: Nothing else that narrows sits beside the results
criteria.note: Retired: Don's 2026-10-18 ruling on #796 and #922 (built in #932) puts a reach line under the search bar, above the results: 'Within 15 minutes of you · Show more nearby', a plain text link that widens the reach one ring, which the sheet's How far group also sets; it hides while a search or filter narrows the list [V, 2026-10-30]. Since #1161 (2026-11-02) the line is gone from Explore; the How far group stays in the sheet [V `ExploreFilterSheet.tsx`]. That is a narrowing control on the results surface, which the 2026-09-19 ruling and this criterion forbid; the newer ruling wins. `sync-roadmap` should amend the scenario; `tests/no-chips.test.ts` keeps it a text link.

criteria.text: Apply closes the panel and writes the selection into the box as readable, retypable text
criteria.note: #750, extended by #881 and #911: the sheet closes and the box reads e.g. 'food & drink this weekend' or 'my interests', plain lowercase words, no hashtag; typed words are kept in front (PM, 2026-10-11) [V]. Checked: `[guards F092.2]` in `BrowseSurface.test.tsx:370` plus `box-text.test.ts:16` (partial); red before green per #750 [V]. Reviewed no (#750 review-skipped; #881, #911 reviewed). Shipped: green on c16c86a7, 3da54545, afcb9111; #1161 (d1267059) and the labelled rows of #1155 (316aa1db) also green, and they keep the box the one state [V]. #619 closed by #750. Smoked: smoke-live run 41884400137 on main 49f942f0 (2026-11-04, root and explore, 10 passed) was green after every merge here; the main runs of 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 (4a632e8a) were red, the 11-06 one on member at explore 1280px ('did not open in time (twice)') and owner personas timing out, so this rests on the 11-04 run [V gh run view]; it loads the route, it does not tap.

criteria.text: Results match the box text, panel-written or typed
criteria.note: `readBox` takes the Type, Category, Date and 'my interests' words out of the box and the rest is the free search; a filter is one targeted `browse_feed` read and search is server-side (#881, #924), so the words and the results come from one state [V]. The reach (`?reach=`, #932) and the area are scope, outside the box, like `?metro=` before them; read here as 'where', not narrowing, per F105's where/what split [A]. Checked: #1064 (2026-10-26, closed #830) added `[guards F092.3]` in `BrowseSurface.test.tsx:431` ('text written by the panel and the same text typed by hand give the same results and the same sheet'), seen failing with tags dropped from the box read [V]. Reviewed no (#750 review-skipped; #881, #924 reviewed; #1064 tests only). Shipped: green on c16c86a7, 3da54545, bc919743, 7f97937e. Smoked: smoke-live run 41884400137 on main 49f942f0 (2026-11-04, root and explore, 10 passed) was green after every merge here; the main runs of 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 (4a632e8a) were red, the 11-06 one on member at explore 1280px ('did not open in time (twice)') and owner personas timing out, so this rests on the 11-04 run [V gh run view]; it loads the route, it does not tap. #620 is open but stale: built and checked; close it.

criteria.text: Text not understood opens the panel; never errors, never silently empties
criteria.note: Free text never errors: unknown words stay as the free search and go to the server (#924), a pending search says 'Searching…' and a failed one says so with Try again (#953), never a false zero; an empty result reads 'Nothing matches … yet' with Clear filters [V `BrowseSurface.tsx` lines 468, 525, 541, 563]. Nothing opens the sheet on text it does not understand: `setSheetOpen(true)` is reached only through the header search's 'More filters' [V]. Replaces #57's chips fallback. Still not built, unchanged since 2026-10-30. Open #622.

criteria.text: Clearing the box clears the narrowing
criteria.note: The box is the narrowing state, so emptying it clears Type, Category, Date and My interests; the search bar's close also clears (`BrowseSurface.tsx`) [V]. The reach and area stay, as scope [A, see 3].
